Name: Dr Darling Replaces Harvey (Control Inspired)
Author: TheDogtorWho
Description:
Based on Dr Darling from Remedy's game Control! 

Mod contains:
- Lines rewritten for files that contain every day dialouge, marriage dialouge and heart events. (To be specific, the 2 and 4 heart events don't have too much change, but 6, 8 and 10 heart events are much more character specific. 14 heart event has had no change.) There are still certain text boxes that will say Harvey's name, but this is mostly objects in his room/ hospital and dialouge from other characters.
- The normal, winter and beach sprites have had a full reskin to resemble Darling.
- Zip folder also has two pages with a guide on how to install the mods. Doesn't require Smapi or content patcher, files can just be swapped into folders.

Mod is english only, since that's the only language I'm fluent in. (Sorry!)
Compatible with 1.6. 

Extra note: Pizza can be given to Darling with a specific positive response, but since it's coded as a dislike for Harvey, I've added an optional file to swap in if you'd prefer this to be changed to a love!

I've loved making this mod (mostly for folks to enjoy, but I think also as someone who just wants to interact with an in game model of Darling. Haha!) Hope you all like it! :D

Feel free to message if you have any questions or spot any issues! :)

No copyright intended on characters referenced from Control, Alan Wake or Max Payne.
